general.heading: General
general.language_help: The language Posthaste's windows are written in.
general.launch_help: Start Posthaste when you sign in, so the shortcut is always ready.
general.minimized_help: Open in the background, without showing this window.
general.minimized_help_no_tray: Open in the background. No system tray was found, so launch Posthaste again to bring this window back.

keyboard.heading: Keyboard
keyboard.capture_help: Opens the Posthaste window from any application.
keyboard.inbox_help: Opens this window on the Inbox.
keyboard.today_help: Opens a small window with today's notes and how many are done.

capture.heading: Capture
capture.position_help: Where each window opens on the display you're working on.
capture.position_help_wayland: On Wayland the compositor decides where windows appear, so this may have no effect.
capture.size_help: How big the capture, Today and details windows open, from the next time they do.
capture.enter_help: The other action is always on Shift+Enter or Ctrl/⌘+Enter.
capture.close_after_save_help: Turn off to capture several notes in a row.
capture.close_on_blur_help: What you typed is kept as a draft either way.
capture.drafts_help: How long an unfinished note waits for you.

data.heading: Data
data.database_help: Your notes live in one file on this computer and are never sent anywhere.
data.export_help: A Markdown file with every note as a checklist, readable in any editor. Choose JSON in the save dialog for tools. Attached files are not included; the backup below has them.
data.import_help: Adds notes from a Posthaste export (Markdown or JSON) or any Markdown checklist. Existing notes are never overwritten.
data.backup_help: A complete copy, including settings and attached files.
data.clear_help: Deletes every note, draft, look and setting. Paired computers are forgotten too. This can't be undone.
data.clear_text: This permanently deletes every note, the current draft, your looks and your settings from this computer. Paired computers are forgotten too. Export or back up first if you might want them again.

devices.heading: Devices
devices.enable_help: Notes go straight to your paired computers, encrypted. If they can't reach each other directly, they pass through a relay that can't read them.
devices.offer_help: Enter this code on your other computer within 10 minutes.
devices.forget_text: Forget {name}? It stops syncing with this computer. Notes already here stay.
devices.relay_help: Used when computers can't connect directly. Leave empty for same-network sync only.

updates.heading: Updates
updates.help: The app checks for updates at most every 6 hours. An update installs in place and Posthaste restarts.
